articles.title: Palmeta is open — send feedback
articles.excerpt: The Palworld toolkit portal is live: tier lists, breeding, team builder, and Paldeck. Tell us what to fix next at support@palmeta.app.

body.text: Palmeta is live — an unofficial Palworld 1.0 toolkit for role tier lists, breeding routes, party builds, and a full Paldeck.

items: Browse combat, work, and mount tier lists
Run the breeding calculator for target pals
Load meta comps or build a custom party of five
Filter the Paldeck by element, work, and combat tier

body.text: Found a wrong tier placement, a broken link, or a missing pal? Email support@palmeta.app — we read every note and prioritize data fixes first.
Palmeta is a fan project and is not affiliated with Pocketpair.
